not_joined: Not connected. Press B and try again; the other Vita must join too.
waiting: Waiting for a Mii. Other Vitas see this one as
looking: Looking for a Vita that is receiving...
choose: Choose who to send the Miis to:
no_answer: Nobody answered. Choose again to retry.
receive_note: On the other Vita, choose Send Mii, then Send to Another Vita. Wireless must be on.
send_note: On the other Vita, choose Receive Mii, then Receive from Another Vita. Wireless must be on.
